name: Cragstone
summary: Cragstone is the capital of the Aluvians, named for Thorsten Cragstone, the second-oldest human settlement on Dereth; it survived three Shadow Spires in 11 PY and is home to the Eldrytch Web and an Arcanum mana forge behind the Hildar House. The town climbs in terraces up an east-facing hillside above Victory Harbor: the lower square (z 32) holds the Statue of Thorsten Cragstone on a 6.8 m plinth, the Town Network portal and the Life Stone among mossy Aluvian halls; Thorsten's Rest inn sits on the z 54 terrace, the Hildar House on the z 70 terrace, and windmills with turning sails stand on the western plateau; a ridge of houses at z 40 drops to the sea on the east and a cliff falls to the harbour on the north.

shots.standingOrder: Start looking straight down at the sunlit bay, then tilt up while drifting in to reveal Cragstone's terraces climbing to the windmill; hold 55 m above the water.
shots.notes: Water opener: starts 58 m above Victory Bay (shallow sea, z 2) looking almost straight down at the water (-80 deg), then tilts up to -5 deg while drifting 10 m in, revealing the sunlit terraces of Cragstone climbing from the shore ridge to the windmill on the skyline (morning sun behind the camera). Nothing within 60 m.

shots.standingOrder: Jib up from the grass in front of the windmill, rising past its turning sails while the arm swings left; stay 14 m from the sails.
shots.notes: Windmill crane: jib rises 14 m from 5 m above the plateau in front of the windmill (24 m south of its turning sails) to above the hub while the arm swings 30 deg; sails stay centred. Side light from the east. Clearance: 19.8 m from the sail disc (blade box), terrain z 67.5-68.7 under the arc.

shots.standingOrder: Look over Thorsten Cragstone's bronze shoulder from his plinth down at the swirling Town Network portal in the square; stay 1 m off the statue.
shots.notes: Landmark: over the bronze shoulder of the Statue of Thorsten Cragstone on his 6.8 m plinth, looking down onto the swirling Town Network portal in the square 26 m away (portal NDC 0.32,-0.15; statue head NDC -0.24,0.20). Camera 2.1 m behind and 0.9 m right of the statue's base centre, 2.1 m above the plinth top (human setup 0x02000001 is 1.82 m; robust to a scaled statue). query-radius 4 m hits only the plinth (by design).

shots.standingOrder: Lock off on the cliff top above Victory Harbor and let the clouds race across the bay while the sun climbs; do not move.
shots.notes: Time-lapse: locked off 10 m above the harbour cliff looking NNE over Victory Harbor; rate 0.01 game-days per film second (sun climbs from 0.42 to 0.54, always up) so the clouds race over the bay. Nearest scenery 11.5 m.

shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up from the statue of Thorsten Cragstone over the rooftops to the harbour cliff in one smooth line; stay 6 m above every roof.
shots.notes: Closing dronie: pulls back and up from the statue (start 12 m, z 49) to 92 m away (z 84) toward the harbour cliff, over the cottage roofs (S74 top 42.2: >= 6.8 m above, 8.8 m min distance). vmax 9.1 m/s.
